purpose: Teach: 悪党/対局/貧血/中性/土砂/憂い/ぞっと/手遅れ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、時代劇の、本気で、絶対、悪党、絶対、像、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on the portrayal of villains in period dramas was really impressive. I was genuinely moved by the depth of it.
lines.style: Warm, observant approval. Open, generous tone. Measured pace. Eyes engaged, nodding slightly as she speaks. Not effusive, but genuinely admiring.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。冷戦時代の、本気で、絶対、対局、絶対、構造、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I was really interested in exploring the structural tensions of the Cold War through that lens. Your feedback meant a lot to me.
lines.style: Grateful and earnest, with a hint of vulnerability. Slight hesitation before diving into the substance—nervous but genuine. Steady eye contact, trying to match her sincerity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時の、本気で、絶対、貧血、絶対、栄養失調、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: What struck me most was how you handled the human costs—the malnutrition, the desperation during wartime. Your perspective was really broad and thoughtful.
lines.style: Reflective, leaning forward slightly. Voice softens with recognition. Speaking from a place of real respect. Unhurried, as if turning something over in her mind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。社会の、本気で、絶対、中性、絶対、的立場、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I appreciated that approach too—trying to maintain an objective stance while still honoring what people went through. That balance was hard to find.
lines.style: Quiet confidence, a touch of relief. Slower pace as he reflects. Earnest without being performative. Slight warmth at being understood.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地理学の、本気で、絶対、土砂、絶対、災害史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you brought in geographic and historical context—the disaster patterns, the regional impacts—that was really sophisticated work.
lines.style: Engaged and specificity-focused. Voice brightens slightly as she recalls details. Speaking with the pleasure of having watched careful thinking unfold. Appreciative cadence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古代詩人の、本気で、絶対、憂い、絶対、文学、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to trace how those anxieties showed up in the literature of the time—the poets, the fear in their words. It felt important to connect those threads.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost careful. Speaking from genuine curiosity about his own work. Modest but not self-effacing. A pause between thoughts, as if still discovering what he meant.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 怪奇文学の、本気で、絶対、ぞっと、絶対、する、絶対、表現、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your section on gothic and supernatural literature was haunting—the way you analyzed those unsettling images. Really skillful critical work.
lines.style: Slightly hushed, almost reverential tone. Voice carries genuine wonder. Measured, deliberate pacing. Speaking as though something has genuinely moved her.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史的に、本気で、絶対、手遅れ、絶対、になった、絶対、政策、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I'm really grateful. That piece on historical catastrophe and failed policy—how people didn't see it coming, or couldn't stop it—that felt urgent and true.
lines.style: Quiet urgency beneath gratitude. Voice steadies on the substantive point. Not rushed, but carrying weight. Slight trailing off, as if something still lingers.
